snippet.title: Headquarters: Cold War | Gameplay trailer
snippet.description:
Headquarters: Cold War is a fast-paced turn-based strategy game set in a hypothetical 1984 conflict between NATO and the USSR.
Play as both sides and command helicopters, tanks, and infantry across 20 campaign missions and rewrite the outcome of modern history.

🎮 Wishlist now on Steam ➡️ https://store.steampowered.com/app/3826370/Headquarters_Cold_War/?beta=0
